run_gradient_ascent_visualization: run gradient ascent visualization for a specific convolutional layer of an alexnet or vgg16 model
run_deprocess_image: run the deprocess_image function to normalize and convert a tensor into a uint8 RGB image array
run_forward_hook: run the forward function to extract activations from a specific layer and channel of a model
review_gradient_ascent_inner: review the gradient_ascent inner function that performs iterative gradient ascent with gaussian blur regularization
review_CONV_channels: review the CONV dictionary that maps alexnet and vgg16 architectures to their per-layer channel counts
